editorial:
Imagine returning to your family home only to find out your ancestors were basically monsters. That is exactly what happens to Tatsuya in this creepy mystery. He comes back to take over the Terada family lead, but he quickly finds himself in a nightmare. The village has a dark history of mass killings, and now someone is killing everyone connected to his family. It feels like a deadly game of hide-and-seek where the killer knows every secret. You will feel the tension as Tatsuya wanders into deep caves and finds weird wax figures that look far too real. It is a wild ride that mixes family drama with a scary slasher vibe.

What really works here is the mystery. You will spend most of the movie trying to guess who is behind the murders and why. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you on your toes, though some parts of the plot move a bit slow. If you love detective stories with a spooky edge, you should definitely check this out. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp cave scenes, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like owning your movies.
endingExplained: The mystery wraps up when Kindaichi reveals the truth about Tatsuya's birth and the family bloodline. The killings were driven by a deep fear of the family curse and a desire to wipe the slate clean. Tatsuya is cornered by the villagers in the caves, but the truth about the past finally comes out. The cycle of violence ends as the secrets of the Eight-Tomb Village are exposed, leaving the survivors to deal with their grief.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark family secrets and detective mysteries.
